## Proxy — stateless mode (§10)

| Row | Status | Proved by / deferred to |
|---|---|---|
| `PB-S-1` | deferred | `PX-4` — Stateless mode. Specified in PX-1, implemented in M2 when the token path gives it a consumer. |
| `PB-S-2` | deferred | `PX-4` — Stateless mode — M2. |
| `PB-S-3` | deferred | `PX-4` — Stateless mode — M2. |
| `PB-S-4` | deferred | `PX-4` — Stateless mode's deterministic branch: a retransmission must produce the byte-identical forwarded message. The stateful engine already derives its branch rather than randomising it, so the property holds today, but the row belongs to the stateless path it is written for — M2. |
